title: Sample and acceptance
table: Accept and reject numbers per class

derivation.one: A lot of {lot} unit is inspected whole.
derivation.general: Lot {lot} · general level {level} → code letter {letter} → inspect {sample}.
derivation.special: Lot {lot} · special level {level} → code letter {letter} → inspect {sample}.
derivation.generalWhole: Lot {lot} · general level {level} → code letter {letter} → inspect all {sample} (the whole lot).
derivation.specialWhole: Lot {lot} · special level {level} → code letter {letter} → inspect all {sample} (the whole lot).

lock: Critical is always 0: one critical defect rejects the lot.
lockLaw: A garment with a safety or compliance defect is never accepted.

line.critical: {klass}: never accepted — one rejects the lot (AQL {aql}, accept {accept}, reject at {reject}).
line.class: {klass}, AQL {aql}: accept up to {accept}, rejects at {reject}.

note.arrowDown: {klass}: Table 2-A points down from letter {letter} to {plan} (a sample of {n}).
note.arrowUp: {klass}: Table 2-A points up from letter {letter} to {plan} (a sample of {n}).
note.stricter: {klass}: its own plan asks {n}; it is judged on the whole sample of {sample}, which is stricter.
note.differ: The classes' plans ask different samples: the largest, {sample}, is inspected.
note.whole: The plan's sample is not smaller than the lot: all {lot} are inspected.
